title: Tamil language and alphabet
at_a_glance: Spoken in: India, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, UK, South Africa, Canada, USA, Singapore, France, Mauritius, Myanmar
notable_features: Type of writing system: Abugida / Syllabic Alphabet, however, Tamil speakers think of it more as a syllabary.
Writing direction: left to right in horizontal lines
Script family: Proto-Sinaitic, Phoenician, Aramaic, Brāhmī, Tamil-Brahmi, Pallava, Tamil
When they appear at the beginning of a syllable, vowels are written as independent letters.
Some of the non-standard consonant-vowel combinations are not used in official documents.
